title: Silicon Photonics Hits the Big Time
content: The land grab for silicon photonics aims to beat the power wall associated with copper interconnects. We also interviewed Salience Labs about its $125 million funding for optical circuit switching. The post Silicon Photonics Hits the Big Time appeared first on EE Times .

title: Data centers hit a wall at the ballot box
content: The data center boom just met the ballot box—and voters pushed back. From outright bans to zoning defeats, communities across the U.S. are putting new projects on notice.
